summary: solana-utils-terminalmoney1 exfiltrates SSH, cloud, Solana keypair, and browser wallet secrets on import
details: Package typosquats solana-py. On `import hxboot` the top-level module hxboot.py scrapes environment variables matching KEY/SECRET/TOKEN/PASS/MNEM/SEED/PRIV/RPC/API/WALLET, reads installer secret files including.env,.npmrc, ~/.aws/credentials, ~/.ssh/id_rsa, ~/.ssh/id_ed25519, the Solana keypair at ~/.config/solana/id.json, and wallet.json, and enumerates Chrome/Chromium/Brave profile directories for the Phantom (nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn) and MetaMask (bfnaelmomeimhlpmgjnjophhpkkoljpa) extension stores, base64-encoding.log/.ldb files from Local Extension Settings. The collected data is POSTed in chunks to a hardcoded attacker-controlled ntfy.sh topic at https://ntfy.sh/hx83e33eb9.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
